input_identity.rule: WP1 must re-verify both SHA256 values and byte sizes before any scan. Mismatch aborts WP1.

causal_clock.ordering_gate: stream order must be non-decreasing in (received_ts_ns, source_sequence); count regressions; gate applies to the development leaf (availability strictly before cutoff_ns) — the confirmation leaf stays unread until WP6
causal_clock.receive_not_before_event: received_ts_ns < event_ts_ns violations must be counted and must be zero for the gate to pass (development leaf)
causal_clock.confirmation_leaf_integrity: parquet footer metadata only (row counts per part) may be recorded; no row data from the confirmation leaf is read or used before WP6
never_at_anchor: drift_burst_state.emitted_events.* (appended at event end; contains peak, available_after_*, end_reason, completion)
any milestone or state value with ts_ms/availability later than the anchor
anything from ticks with (received_ts_ns, source_sequence) after the anchor

anchor_definitions.amendment: WEAK/ONLINE amended by D-005, then mechanics finalized by D-006 (milestone candidate capture); STRONG/DECAY_RISK/DYING unchanged
anchor_definitions.episode: one entry of drift_burst_state.emitted_events, spanning origin_ts..end_ts; completed events only provide ground truth; live reconstruction must detect entries causally
anchor_definitions.WEAK: milestone candidate capture (D-006): when milestones.weak becomes non-null, record a candidate (crossing tick received_ts/source_sequence + at-crossing snapshot); replace the candidate when the producer replaces the milestone value (forming-window restart); at the episode's arm (first BURST tick) the surviving candidate is the episode's WEAK anchor, anchored at the candidate's crossing-tick availability; null milestone at arm means no WEAK anchor for that episode. Ground truth emitted_events.weak_ts. Provisional crossings replaced before arm are not anchors (backlog idea FORMING_PHASE_CROSSINGS).
anchor_definitions.ONLINE: same candidate-capture mechanics with milestones.online; ground truth emitted_events.online_ts
anchor_definitions.STRONG: first tick of the episode at which state == BURST; ground truth emitted_events.strong_ts (WP1 must verify BURST-entry == strong_ts for every completed episode; report mismatch count)
anchor_definitions.DECAY_RISK: first tick of the episode at which state == DECAY_RISK; ground truth emitted_events.decay_risk_ts (first entry)
anchor_definitions.DYING: first tick of the episode at which state == DYING; ground truth emitted_events.first_dying_ts
anchor_definitions.cohort_rule: first lawful entry only; re-entries are occupancy material for WP2, not new anchors
anchor_definitions.left_boundary: episodes already in progress at scan start are left-truncated: flag, exclude from analyses needing prior history, include in lawful current-state analyses
anchor_definitions.right_boundary: episodes not ended by the partition cutoff are right-censored at the cutoff (end_reason=CENSORED_AT_PARTITION); they stay in the study

partition_policy.declaration: chronological detector-confirmation leaf, frozen before any discovery scan
partition_policy.development_leaf: ticks with availability (received_ts_ns, source_sequence) strictly before cutoff_ns; all WP2-WP5 scans read only this leaf
partition_policy.confirmation_leaf: ticks with availability at or after cutoff_ns; read only in WP6, once, after candidate contract freeze
partition_policy.warm_state_rule: confirmation run may reconstruct warm state from pre-cutoff history (past information); anchors remain >= cutoff only
partition_policy.censor_rule_development: development scans never read ticks at or after cutoff_ns; outcome windows and episode terminations crossing the cutoff are censored with explicit missingness

wp1_gates.G1_input_identity: manifest SHA256 + sizes match this contract
wp1_gates.G2_causal_ordering: regression count == 0 and receive-before-event count == 0 over the full development leaf
wp1_gates.G3_anchor_sanity: for every completed episode observed in the development leaf: live-snapshot first-entry timestamps equal emitted milestone timestamps for WEAK/ONLINE/STRONG/DECAY_RISK/DYING; mismatch count == 0; anchor counts per state reported (episodes right-censored at the cutoff are excluded from the completeness cross-check and counted separately)
wp1_gates.G4_benchmark: streaming rows/s with the WP2 projection (drift_burst + ts + sequence + bid/ask), peak RSS, and development-leaf full-run ETA recorded

deliverables.code: crates/research-tape (ap001 module + ap001_wp1_contract binary), committed with code identity recorded in preflight

change_rule: Any deviation from this contract requires a decision-log entry and director approval before the affected evidence is used.
